sales_hooks: Vertiv is the only certified UPS for NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 — every HBM-packed Blackwell rack requires Vertiv power infrastructure. HBM density growth directly drives Vertiv's addressable market.
HBM generates 3-5x more heat per rack than DRAM — liquid cooling is no longer optional. Vertiv's CDU backlog is a leading indicator of HBM deployment velocity at hyperscalers.
Vertiv order backlog: $7.5B (record) — visibility into where new AI compute is being built. Use Vertiv's geographic deployment data as a proxy for where HBM demand will land.
As HBM stacks go from 8-Hi to 12-Hi, power per GPU rises from 700W to 1200W+ — Vertiv is a direct beneficiary of every HBM generation step-up.
